purpose: Twenty-second-round runtime evidence for three named complete P1 PHP, Java, and Rust core body programs.
isolation: No network, read-only container root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, bounded CPU/memory/PIDs, and tmpfs-only writable workspace. Images were required to exist because --pull=never was used.
scope: Only the three unique named complete fences were extracted unchanged after CRLF-to-LF normalization and executed. Other prose/fences, framework integration, HTTP, filesystem behavior, concurrency, performance, Miri/sanitizers, external dependencies, and full projects remain outside this evidence.

results.docker_command: docker run --rm -i --pull=never --network=none --read-only --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=64 --memory=512m --cpus=1 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m php:8.5-cli-alpine sh -c 'cat > /tmp/main.php && exec "$@"' document-program php /tmp/main.php

docker run --rm -i --pull=never --network=none --read-only --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=64 --memory=512m --cpus=1 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-noble sh -c 'cat > /tmp/Main.java && exec "$@"' document-program sh -c 'javac --release 21 -encoding UTF-8 -d /tmp /tmp/Main.java && java -cp /tmp Main'

docker run --rm -i --pull=never --network=none --read-only --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges --pids-limit=64 --memory=512m --cpus=1 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m rust:1-slim-bookworm sh -c 'cat > /tmp/main.rs && exec "$@"' document-program sh -c 'rustc --edition 2024 /tmp/main.rs -o /tmp/main && /tmp/main'
